title: Think For Yourself
lyrics_synced:
[00:04.32] I've got a word or two
[00:07.95] to say about the things that you do.
[00:15.23] You're telling all those lies,
[00:18.86] about the good things that we can have,
[00:22.50] if we close our eyes.
[00:25.45] Do what you want to do,
[00:28.86] and go where you're going to.
[00:32.73] Think for yourself,
[00:34.09] 'cause I won't be there with you!
[00:40.68] I left you far behind
[00:44.32] the ruins of the life that you had in mind.
[00:51.59] And though you still can't see.
[00:55.23] I know your mind's made up,
[00:57.50] you're gonna cause more misery!
[01:01.82] Do what you want to do,
[01:05.23] and go where you're going to.
[01:09.09] Think for yourself,
[01:10.45] 'cause I won't be there with you!
[01:17.05] Although your mind's opaque,
[01:20.68] try thinking more if just for your own sake.
[01:27.95] The future still looks good,
[01:31.59] and you've got time to rectify
[01:34.77] all the things that you should.
[01:38.18] Do what you want to do,
[01:41.59] and go where you're going to.
[01:45.45] Think for yourself,
[01:46.82] 'cause I won't be there with you!
[01:52.73] Do what you want to do,
[01:56.14] and go where you're going to.
[01:60.00] Think for yourself,
[02:01.36] 'cause I won't be there with you!
[02:07.27] Think for yourself,
[02:08.64] 'cause I won't be there with you!
